items.stem: A survey drone unexpectedly loses its control link mid-flight. What is the most responsible designed behaviour?

options.text: Execute a predefined failsafe such as return-to-home or a safe controlled landing
options.rationale: Correct: a safe, predefined failsafe protects people and property on loss of link.

options.text: Continue the mission indefinitely with no link
options.rationale: Flying on blindly without control is unsafe.

options.text: Immediately cut all power and drop from the sky
options.rationale: An uncontrolled fall endangers people and property.

options.text: Speed up to finish before anyone notices
options.rationale: This is unsafe and ignores the loss-of-control situation.

items.explanation: Correct: a safe, predefined failsafe protects people and property on loss of link.

items.stem: Which TWO statements about drone platforms are accurate? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Multirotors hover well and suit close inspection tasks
options.rationale: Correct: multirotors excel at hovering and precise positioning.

options.text: Fixed-wing drones generally cover large areas more efficiently
options.rationale: Correct: fixed-wing platforms offer longer range and endurance for area coverage.

options.text: All drones can hover indefinitely regardless of design
options.rationale: Fixed-wing drones generally cannot hover like multirotors.

options.text: Payload choice never affects the mission outcome
options.rationale: Payload is central to what a mission can achieve.

items.explanation: Correct: multirotors excel at hovering and precise positioning.

items.stem: Why must drone operators consider airspace rules before flying?

options.text: Drones share airspace with other aircraft and people, so rules exist to keep operations safe and legal
options.rationale: Correct: responsible operation requires respecting airspace and safety regulations.

options.text: Because airspace rules only apply to large passenger jets
options.rationale: Rules apply to drone operations too, not just large aircraft.

options.text: Because following rules makes the battery last longer
options.rationale: Rules concern safety and legality, not battery life.

options.text: Because airspace rules determine the drone's colour
options.rationale: Rules govern safe operation, not cosmetic choices.

items.explanation: Correct: responsible operation requires respecting airspace and safety regulations.
